# Support

Issues are switched off in this repository.

- **Bugs in the Australian layer:** use the [contact page](https://duguid.com.au/contact/). Give the version or commit, the command you ran, the result you expected and the result you received, with the smallest reproduction you can make from fabricated data.
- **Bugs or ideas for the shared openfpa kernel:** use [openfpa's issues](https://github.com/JeffBrines/openfpa/issues).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and never report one publicly.

Never send client, taxpayer, employee, payroll, banking or credential data. There is no service level agreement or guaranteed response time.
